description.value: Green Leaf Salad Bar is a Lebanese restaurant and by-weight salad bar in Vancouver's West End, celebrated as a Readers' Choice 'Best of the City 2014' winner by WE Vancouver and a four-time consecutive Yelp People's Choice award recipient (2016–2019). The menu centres on Lebanese staples — chicken shawarma, falafel wraps, daily rotating hot specials such as beef kafta and moussaka — alongside a fresh seasonal salad bar priced by weight. A touring cyclist stopping here will find a compact, fast-casual spot with both indoor and outdoor seating and a full catering operation.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the OSM address (560 Bute Street, Vancouver, BC V6E 3M1) and the restaurant's identity. The menu explicitly lists a 'Vegetarian Plate' and the catering page labels items with (VG), (GF), and (DF) dietary codes, confirming vegetarian and GF options. Two different phone numbers appear on the website: the Contact section and catering page show (604)677-5650 while the site footer consistently shows (604)-677-5550 — this discrepancy is flagged; the Contact section number is used as primary. No bike parking, washroom, Wi-Fi, or water-refill information appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: Phone number discrepancy on website: Contact section and catering page show (604)677-5650 while the site footer shows (604)-677-5550 — digits differ at positions 8-9 (5650 vs 5550); one is likely a typo. OSM carries no phone number so cross-check is not possible.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Lebanese restaurant with an active website, confirmed address, current menu, and multiple recent awards. Clearly useful to touring cyclists seeking a meal.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists a dedicated 'Vegetarian Plate' (falafel, hummus, salads) and 'Falafel Wrap'; catering page labels Tabouleh and Fattoush as (VG, DF) and Hummus and Fattoush as (GF)
